review.notes: Full structure check (no code fences; heading set and numbered-superscript markers match the printed card, and the References list resolves them) plus word-level diff of all OCR lines against extracted text from all 29 physical PDF pages. The systematic defect is dropped chart-footnote bodies: every '*'/'†'/'‡' note printed below the charts or under the introductory sentences is missing from the OCR while its inline marker survives; all 18 dropped notes plus the title-block 'Revision: 2026-07-20' line are restored here from the printed pages. Words missing from the OCR that were NOT patched are figure-internal chart labels and legends (bar labels, axis titles, legend entries) shown by the embedded chart images. Footnote text was extracted from the PDF text layer at page-bottom positions; the DeepSWE v1.0 image crop was visually inspected to confirm the embedded chart ends at the axis label and excludes the footnote. Escaped '\*' keeps the printed asterisk from becoming a Markdown bullet, and '$^{†}$'/'$^{\ddagger}$' reuse the document's existing marker convention.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.1 title block prints 'Model Card: Grok 4.5 / July 14, 2026 / Revision: 2026-07-20'; OCR dropped the revision line. The patch restores it after the date.
